# Gramlot 0.3.26

Consolidates the reviewed common base: shared form/Grid editing and validation, TreeStore search and lazy checks, selector caption fields, uploader/attachment/image controls, and the Visual Editor. Widget state stays with Source and Data; content updates retain their instances.

DOMPurify is shared by the runtime with separate component policies. Markdown parsing is shared and loaded on demand, including verified exports opened from file. External editor engines remain lazy.

Native iframe database ownership, collection preparation and regression coverage are included. The documented WebKit local-file upload limitation remains; binary HTTP uploads currently require the Uvicorn host. Invoice application, Python compiled-page export, full form persistence/undo-redo and the future dbQuery/dataSelection design are excluded.

The unpublished 0.3.25 candidate was stopped by an inspector test-build import mapping. The mapping is corrected; no released tag is rewritten.
